research_summary: The single most important finding: the brand kit's planned generic sustainability messaging ("Beautiful clothing that doesn't cost the earth") is a real credibility risk, not just soft copy — ~60% of fashion sustainability claims are unsubstantiated, and 73% of this exact audience has abandoned a purchase after spotting a poor environmental record. Since we also lack live-model footage (only product cutouts), the winning move is to combine two adaptations into one concept: replace vague sustainability copy with one specific, verifiable claim, and replace the assumed model-wearing shots with a kinetic hero-product reveal — a format that independently performs well on sound-off, scrolling platforms.
